The '''Rainbow Labyrinth crystal''' was a famous [[tasar crystal]] that was found on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It featured multiple [[Color/Legends|colors]], which contributed to its high value, and at some point by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was sold for fifty million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rainbow Labyrinth crystal was mentioned in "[[Tasariq: The Crystal Planet]]," a [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tom Moldvay]] and [[Steve Miller]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal15" />
